marco: Quick thread  I added a short changelog block for the docs release. Need a fast pass: update SDK snippets, call out any Known issues, and a one-line Dedicated platform note. PTAL :eyes:
anya: Link?
marco: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/relnotes/draft-3505  Heads-up: embeddings API surface changed; runtime exposes `embeddings.create_v2` (Python) and JS uses `createV2`.
sasha: I'll update the Python inline to be minimal: `resp = client.embeddings.create_v2(model="rwd-embed-1", input=["hello"])`
olivia: I'll take JS. Inline suggestion: `const resp = await client.embeddings.createV2({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: ['hello'] })` Note casing difference in migration guide.
marco: Add a Known issue: quantized models on older GPUs can show small logit differences for long contexts (>2048). Link to bug RED-2146 and add a 1-2 line troubleshooting tip recommending a quick re-eval in full precision.
ci-bot: CI for PR #8503: linkcheck failed (rollout-policy anchor missing), lint passed. https://ci.internal/builds/8503
anya: I'll patch the anchor and run linkcheck locally.
olivia: After that, can someone preview staging and confirm snippet rendering + migration link?
marco: Yes. Targeting merge once staging green; schedule publish Wed 10:00 PT.
anya: Fixed anchor and pushed. Ran linkcheck: clean.
ci-bot: Updated CI: linkcheck passed, staging build queued.
sasha: Preview looks good; inline snippets render and links resolve. Small copy tweak pushed.
marco: Thanks everyone. Merge when CI clears.
